stage0097_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So that's... what's left of $$アクシズ$$...」

stage0097_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（The will of the people kept $$アクシズ$$ from falling to Earth...
　In the end, does that mean we... gave up our revenge...）

stage0097_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Is it because of that light that wrapped around $$アクシズ$$?」

stage0097_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アレク$$
「You... what did you wish for in that light?」

stage0097_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$フラスト$$
「...Like hell I'd say.
　What about you, then?」

stage0097_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Tch...
　What about the captain?」

stage0097_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I don't even remember anymore...」

stage0097_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（$$バナージ$$...
　Is this... because I met a man like you...）

stage0097_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（Damn it... damn it...!
　I'm sorry... Marie...）

stage0097_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アレク$$
「Contact near the wreckage of $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0097_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$アレク$$
「What'll it be, captain?
　Do we engage?」

stage0097_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Confirmed: continuous distortion in
　the dimensional boundary!」

stage0097_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ボビー$$
「This mottled universe...!
　There's no mistaking it!」

stage0097_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Well done, everyone.
　It seems $$時空修復$$ destroyed the Prison of Time.」

stage0097_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I've also received confirmation from
　Dr. $$トライア$$! $$エタニティ・フラット$$ has been averted!」

stage0097_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「We did it...!
　You did it, $n!」

stage0097_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So, this is humanity's choice.」

stage0097_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Did everyone wish for the Prison
　of Time to be destroyed?」

stage0097_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No, that's not it.
　This is simply the shape of one possibility.」

stage0097_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If there were people who wished for the
　Prison of Time to continue, they likely
　created that parallel world, and live there now.」

stage0097_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The flow of time hasn't fully returned to
　normal yet, but judging by the state of the
　surrounding dimensional boundary...」

stage0097_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The barrier isolating our world from the
　surrounding dimensions should vanish completely soon.」

stage0097_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that moment will be the Prison
　of Time's true end.」

stage0097_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$隼人$$
「But that means a war with $$バアル$$.」

stage0097_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「It's the answer we all chose.
　Don't go nitpicking it.」

stage0097_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right!
　If space monsters or $$インベーダー#keyword$$s
　come, we'll just have to face them!」

stage0097_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Captain Testarossa...
　Did you know that Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others
　were preparing for $$時空修復$$?」

stage0097_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...I wasn't informed of the details.
　I was only told that $c should
　keep fighting...」

stage0097_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Seems the doctors were making their
　move while we kept Geminis and
　Chrono's attention on us.」

stage0097_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$シャア$$
「...How unsightly...
　To have survived, of all things...」

stage0097_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I am $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0097_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then, from now on,
　I'll call you Colonel.」

stage0097_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$キラ$$
「You won't be returning to
　Neo Zeon anymore, will you?」

stage0097_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$シャア$$
「In the end, I couldn't live up to
　their expectations.
　Such a man has no right to be Supreme Commander.」

stage0097_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シャア$$
「The rest, I'll leave to $$ハマーン$$.」

stage0097_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シン$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

stage0097_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シャア$$
「I intend to take responsibility
　as the one who started this war.」

stage0097_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But you are not permitted to call
　your own death payment enough,
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0097_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$五飛$$
「If that's the path you choose,
　this time I will despise you,
　to the very bottom of my heart.」

stage0097_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$シン$$
「You will take responsibility
　by fighting alongside us.」

stage0097_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Geminis, the root of it all...
　the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$, who declared
　humanity's annihilation... and $$バアル$$, too.」

stage0097_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you're a skilled pilot with
　nowhere else to go, we'll hire you.」

stage0097_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「The Red Comet, a mere $$ミスリル$$
　foot soldier...
　$$マオ$$ will likely enjoy drilling him.」

stage0097_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アルト$$
「There's also the option of
　joining $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$.」

stage0097_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you join $$２１世紀警備保障$$,
　you'd go straight from Supreme
　Commander to entry-level employee.」

stage0097_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way, Mr. $$赤木$$!
　Colonel $$シャア$$ is coming to work
　for us!」

stage0097_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Looks like you won't be short on
　job offers, Colonel.」

stage0097_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You've fulfilled your responsibility
　as the singularity.」

stage0097_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand it now.
　Why you believed in this outcome...
　that $$アクシズ$$ wouldn't fall to Earth.」

stage0097_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シャア$$
「...The long-accumulated rage and hatred
　of the Spacenoids was seeking
　a concrete outlet...」

stage0097_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And that's what this war...」

stage0097_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シャア$$
「The $$アクシズ$$ Drop was also that final form...
　But I believed that in the final moment,
　reason would make people reject what I'd done.」

stage0097_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シャア$$
「There's one more thing I believed in...
　It's all of you.」

stage0097_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right...
　$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, who succeeded in $$時空修復$$ for $$ＵＣＷ$$,
　and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, who ended the war for $$ＡＤＷ$$...」

stage0097_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シャア$$
「And all of you, who've fought for
　the world until today, $c...」

stage0097_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Your fighting spirit itself was the
　final key that gathered together the
　hearts twisted by Geminis and Chrono.」

stage0097_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right. Even with the singularity
　and the system in place, $$時空修復$$
　means nothing unless people's will unites.」

stage0097_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シャア$$
「Something for people to pour their
　wishes into... That's what you all are.」

stage0097_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even with Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others ready,
　and with me holding back $$フロンタル$$,
　the world couldn't have been saved without you.」

stage0097_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The people dragged along by your
　romanticism have it rough.」

stage0097_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And in the end, it turned out
　just as you wished.」

stage0097_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シャア$$
「Humanity will change from here...
　I believe in the future from
　this point on, too.」

stage0097_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「See that for yourself, with
　your own eyes.」

stage0097_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$刹那$$
「With the $$アクシズ$$ Drop, their final operation, a failure,
　and the Supreme Commander missing,
　the Federation-Neo Zeon war will fizzle out.」

stage0097_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Under these circumstances,
　$$ハマーン・カーン$$ likely won't resort
　to aggressive tactics either.」

stage0097_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What about $$フル・フロンタル$$...?」

stage0097_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll pursue Geminis.
　That will inevitably mean fighting
　Chrono too.」

stage0097_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$シャア$$
「...They've lurked in Earth's shadows,
　pressuring the governments of the age
　to oppress the Spacenoids.」

stage0097_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「To think that people like them are
　scheming in secret across the
　multiverse too...」

stage0097_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シャア$$
「I too know little about Chrono.
　But defeating them should bring change
　to the relationship between the colonies and Earth.」

stage0097_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$...
　If you still have the resolve of
　the Red Comet in you, come with us.」

stage0097_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Earth or the colonies, it doesn't
　matter. We fight to protect the
　future people wished for.」

stage0097_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$クェス$$
「Of course, I'm coming too,
　Colonel.」

stage0097_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$カツ$$
「Looks like the fight to win back
　$$クェス$$ isn't over yet.」

stage0097_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Captain, what do we do about
　the Neo Zeon fleet?」

stage0097_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They don't seem to have any
　intention of engaging. We should
　be fine to keep observing as we are.」

stage0097_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Will the war really come to an end?」

stage0097_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Once it comes to war with $$バアル$$,
　there won't be room for humanity
　to keep fighting itself.」

stage0097_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sure $$ハマーン・カーン$$
　understands that too.」

stage0097_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「So once we crush Geminis and the
　Chrono within the Earth Federation,
　humanity will become one, correct?」

stage0097_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... And after that, there's
　that plan we've had in the works
　for some time...」

stage0097_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ボビー$$
「They barely lifted a finger till now,
　so what are they doing here at
　this point!」

stage0097_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$サイガス$$
「All ships, commence attack on
　Neo Zeon!」

stage0097_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Those bastards!
　They mean to fight, even now!?」

stage0097_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Cease fire, Brigadier General
　$$サイガス$$! Neo Zeon has no
　intention of engaging!」

stage0097_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$サイガス$$
「The likes of special forces don't get a say
　in Supreme Command's decisions!
　Now's the perfect chance to wipe out Zeon for good!」

stage0097_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, prepare for battle!」

stage0097_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This isn't a normal war anymore.
　I won't turn a blind eye to slaughter like this.」

stage0097_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$オズマ$$
「You heard the man!
　Let's go!」

stage0097_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$赤木$$
「The war's already over!
　How can we let something like that slide!」

stage0097_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カレン$$
「You lackey of Chrono!
　I know you've been working with Geminis!」

stage0097_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Fall back, $$ジンネマン$$!
　We'll handle the rest!」

stage0097_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Fall back!
　Anyone who doesn't want to die, follow the $$ガランシェール$$!!」

stage0097_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Damn you, $c!
　Defying Supreme Command!?」

stage0097_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We've been granted the right to act independently.
　I'm simply exercising that right.」

stage0097_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Good timing.
　Now I have a reason to crush you head-on.」

stage0097_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Even with the $$大統領$$'s backing,
　you won't be able to talk your way out of this!
　Prepare yourself!」

stage0097_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Please be careful!
　Something else is coming!」

stage0097_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...What the hell is this...」

stage0097_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Why!?
　Why did you pull it off!?」

stage0097_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「With all those obstacles in your way,
　how did you manage to save the Earth!?
　This doesn't make any damn sense!!」

stage0097_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...
　The reason for your defeat is that you were
　too distracted by $c.」

stage0097_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シャア$$
「In that opening, I was able to proceed
　with preparations for the $$時空修復$$.」

stage0097_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Our Geminai was destroyed!
　Why was your planet saved!?
　How is that fair!!」

stage0097_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$サイガス$$
「G-Geminis...!
　Weren't you here to back us up!?」

stage0097_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$サイガス$$
「W-we're your collaborators!
　As members of Chrono, we upheld the doctrine...」

stage0097_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Shut the hell up!
　You scumbag!!」

stage0097_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$タケル$$
「He executed Chrono, his own collaborator!?」

stage0097_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Wh-why!?
　We were your collaborators! We upheld the doctrine,
　and worked toward humanity's evolution...」

stage0097_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A guy who sold out his own planet
　has no right to talk so big!!」

stage0097_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Get out of my sight, you bastard!!」

stage0097_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Damn it...! Daaaamn it all!!」

stage0097_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...The nuisance is gone.
　Well then, let's get started, $n.」

stage0097_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We've broken your Prison of Time!
　Now surrender quietly!」

stage0097_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Stop it, $$アンナロッタ$$.」

stage0097_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's true they pulled off the $$時空修復$$.
　I'll give them that much credit.」

stage0097_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But it's about time the dream ended.」

stage0097_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
Geminis
「So the captain means business too...!」

stage0097_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This is my answer, $$アンナロッタ$$.」

stage0097_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I can believe that, can't I?」

stage0097_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$桂$$
「Yeah, yeah.
　Cut the 'I wasn't really trying' act already.」

stage0097_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let me tell you something!
　Our anger's about to explode!」

stage0097_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$シモン$$
「We broke the Prison of Time, and next
　we're gonna crush you!!」

stage0097_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$n...!
　$$シモン$$ volunteered to back you up himself!
　Give it everything you've got!」

stage0097_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...How noble, how wonderful, what a hero...
　Gathering the hopes of everyone across the world,
　to settle things with the source of it all, huh...」

stage0097_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But... what's waiting for you is a cruel ending!
　Reality's always merciless!」

stage0097_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アムロ$$
「This isn't the $$ガドライト$$ we knew...!?」

stage0097_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Please be careful!
　We're detecting unknown energy from his $$ジェミニア$$!」

stage0097_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$宗介$$
「What is this... If I lower my guard,
　my will to fight begins to wither...!」

stage0097_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that's the power of the $$スフィア$$ that man wields...!」

stage0097_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Heh... Seems like, of all times, I've now
　fully entered the Third Stage.」

stage0097_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So this power is my Sphere Act, huh!」

stage0097_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Come on, $n... and you Earthlings!
　I'll show you your fate!」

stage0097_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「H-how careless of me...!」

stage0097_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Fall back, $$アンナロッタ$$!」

stage0097_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you and the child in your belly die,
　that's the end of the Geminaid!」

stage0097_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Even so, I don't care!」

stage0097_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If losing someone you love is what brings back
　your rage and your pride, then I...!」

stage0097_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Without paying a price like that,
　can I not fight at all...」

stage0097_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't worry, $$アンナロッタ$$.
　I won't lose, even without doing something like that.」

stage0097_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll wrap this up in no time and be right back.
　Love you, my sweet honey.」

stage0097_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If something happens to me, run...
　Get away from Earth before he gets here.」

stage0097_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$n
「Guess even a bastard's gentle with his own woman.」

stage0097_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Look at this brat, talking like he's somebody.」

stage0097_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But don't get the wrong idea.
　She's less my woman than she is
　the future mother of the Geminaid.」

stage0097_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Guess I went and told you a boring story.
　As an apology, I'll give you a present.」

stage0097_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You really are battle-hardened.
　A bit stronger than I expected.」

stage0097_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Is that supposed to be flattery!?」

stage0097_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you have the leisure to make pointless jokes?」

stage0097_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I keep telling you.
　No matter how hard you all try,
　impossible is impossible.」

stage0097_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll show you that right now!」

stage0097_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

stage0097_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahahaha!
　You've seen this a few times before, haven't you?
　Even I can pull off this much!」

stage0097_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Space monsters and $$インベーダー#keyword$$!」

stage0097_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That guy...!
　Did he do the same thing as $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!?」

stage0097_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Correct.
　And I brought in a real hardcore one, too.」

stage0097_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Quit screwing around!
　You think this is a game!?」

stage0097_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That guy...!
　Are you saying he's got power on par with
　$$ミカゲ$$ or $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!?」

stage0097_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well, I am technically a Third-Stage
　$$スフィア・リアクター$$, after all.」

stage0097_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$シャア$$
「The power to amplify the opposing will
　hidden in one's heart, and the power to warp
　time and space and call forth $$バアル$$...」

stage0097_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And to think he can freely trigger $$時空震動$$,
　and even create the Prison of Time on top of it...」

stage0097_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So this is a Reactor's true power...!」

stage0097_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This much, even I can pull off now.」

stage0097_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「In other words, every Reactor
　you've faced 'til now was still small-time!」

stage0097_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$葵$$
「To think that even $$アイム$$ or Prince $$ユーサー$$
　hadn't drawn out their full power yet...!」

stage0097_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now then... the tables have turned.
　Get ready.」

stage0097_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't give up, $n...!
　Show a guy like that any weakness,
　and he'll jump right on it!」

stage0097_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「As expected of the Man of the Spiral.
　Quite the positive thinker.」

stage0097_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But...!
　Reality's this cruel!
　Miracles just don't happen!」

stage0097_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$シモン$$
「Say that after you've crushed me!!」

stage0097_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ギミー$$
「You can't just charge in alone!」

stage0097_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Push through the impossible,
　and kick common sense out of the way!
　That's my way!!」

stage0097_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$シモン$$...!
　You don't mean...!?」

stage0097_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$キタン$$
「You're gonna be bait to lure those monsters in!?」

stage0097_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Screw this up and you'll die.」

stage0097_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$シモン$$
「If you're scared, you can run!」

stage0097_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Quit joking around.
　I'll go with you to the depths of hell, $$シモン$$!」

stage0097_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「I brought Arc-Gurren!
　Time to combine, $$シモン$$!」

stage0097_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$弁慶$$
「This is bad!
　Not even Arc-Gurren Lagann can stand up to it!?」

stage0097_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Please wait, $$シモン$$!
　I'm coming now!」

stage0097_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「He risked his life alone to save you all.
　Let's honor that, shall we」

stage0097_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$シモン$$
「Doesn't mean I plan on dying, though!!」

stage0097_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Then, Man of the Spiral.
　Pierce through dimensions」

stage0097_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$リーロン$$
「That's right, $$シモン$$!
　That's exactly why we brought Arc-Gurren!」

stage0097_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「With the current dimensional boundary, we can call it forth.
　Our legacy, sunk into the dimensional gap during our last battle...」

stage0097_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$シベラ$$
「Damage across every part of Arc-Gurren Lagann!」

stage0097_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ガバル$$
「No good!
　Can't dodge any more of these!」

stage0097_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$テツカン$$
「This is bad!
　At this rate, even Arc-Gurren Lagann...!」

stage0097_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Hurry, $$シモン$$!
　We're betting everything on your drill!」

stage0097_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$バサラ$$
「This is... a shout that shakes space and time!!」

stage0097_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Now, it awakens...!
　My ship, Cathedral Terra!」

stage0097_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$キタン$$
「It's huge!
　An insanely huge battleship!!」

stage0097_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「An ultra-dreadnought-class space battleship...
　The ship we used in our war against the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$,
　its name, Cathedral Terra...」

stage0097_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$タケル$$
「The other moon that fell during the $$再世戦争$$!」

stage0097_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That's right.
　After we lost to the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$,
　they turned it into a system to annihilate mankind」

stage0097_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ガバル$$
「Alright!
　This ship is ours now!」

stage0097_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$リーロン$$
「$$ダヤッカ$$!
　$$バアル$$'s coming!」

stage0097_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Intercept it, $$アーテンボロー$$!!」

stage0097_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Not bad at all!
　This power!」

stage0097_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「As expected of Cathedral Terra...
　It seems it repaired itself while it lay fallen in the dimensional gap」

stage0097_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$リーロン$$
「It suits you, $$シモン$$!
　The new outfit I gave you... You're already wearing it!」

stage0097_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$シモン$$
「This ship isn't Cathedral Terra!
　It's $$超銀河ダイグレン$$!!」

stage0097_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Man of the Spiral, are you making even this ship your own power now?」

stage0097_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It pisses me off!
　That positivity of yours!!」

stage0097_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Came to back us up, $$竜馬$$!」

stage0097_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Like hell I'd do something half-assed like that!」

stage0097_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Just what it looks like.
　I put some spirit into it」

stage0097_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Thanks, $$竜馬$$.
　That snapped me right back into shape!」

stage0097_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
（Warrior of the Getter rays...
　Have you accelerated the Man of the Spiral's evolution...）

stage0097_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here we go!
　Time to transform!!」

stage0097_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Man of the Spiral, are you making even this ship your own power now?」

stage0097_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It pisses me off!
　That positivity of yours!!」

stage0097_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Came to back us up, $$號$$!」

stage0097_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$凱$$
「That was a direct hit from a Getter Beam!」

stage0097_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$キタン$$
「Hey, come on!
　Say something, $$號$$!」

stage0097_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$シモン$$
「Thanks, $$號$$.
　That got me fired up!」

stage0097_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
（Apostle of the Getter rays...
　Have you accelerated the Man of the Spiral's evolution...）

stage0097_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here we go!
　Time to transform!!」

stage0097_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Man of the Spiral, are you making even this ship your own power now?」

stage0097_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here we go!
　Time to transform!!」

stage0097_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'll carve my friends' hearts into this body and turn endless dark to light!
　Heaven and earth, one machine worth a god!
　$$超銀河グレンラガン$$!!」

stage0097_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$隼人$$
「The power of $$グレンラガン$$ stored within $$超銀河ダイグレン$$!」

stage0097_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$シモン$$
「This power!
　Watch this! Here I goooo!!」

stage0097_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Amazing...!
　That's too amazing, $$シモン$$!!」

stage0097_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$シモン$$
「My drill never stops!
　No matter who I'm up against, no matter what comes!!」

stage0097_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$シモン$$!
　Leave the bombardment to us Dai-Gurren crew!」

stage0097_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Fire, fire, I'll fire nonstop!!」

stage0097_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$リーロン$$
「We'll operate $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ as a battleship!
　If things get dangerous, everyone evacuate here, okay!」

stage0097_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What the hell is that...」

stage0097_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What the hell is thaaaat!!」

stage0097_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What the hell are you people!
　One after another!」

stage0097_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's messed up!
　It's not fair!!」

stage0097_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Why must our planet Geminai perish while your Earth gets protected!?
　Is this what you call fate!」

stage0097_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「'$$いがみ合う双子$$'...
　I've finally figured out the conditions that trigger it」

stage0097_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Conflicting emotions that exist within a single person...
　I see the resignation and anger inside you drawing out the $$スフィア$$'s power」

stage0097_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「How fragile you are, $$ガドライト$$.
　To fly into such a rage just from having your inner self touched a little」

stage0097_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, you actually came, $$アドヴェント$$!」

stage0097_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Just as she pointed out.
　You feel a fierce anger at your home's
　destruction, and resignation at your own weakness」

stage0097_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That contradiction is the $$スフィア$$
　mounted in $$ジェミニア$$... it's what powers
　the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'」

stage0097_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yeah, that's right! Our planet Geminai
　doesn't even exist in this galaxy anymore!」

stage0097_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And yet, why! Why was your Earth
　spared and sealed in an isolated dimension,
　instead of being wiped out!」

stage0097_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're saying the Prison of Time
　was meant to protect Earth!?」

stage0097_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$甲児$$
「What do you mean by that!?」

stage0097_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I won't forgive this...!
　I'll never forgive it!」

stage0097_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「There's no way eternity should be
　allowed! It's only right that you all
　perish too, just like us Geminaids!!」

stage0097_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's why I did it!
　I set you all up to wipe each other out!」

stage0097_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$n
「So basically, you tried to destroy
　Earth out of jealousy?」

stage0097_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$n
「And that composed way you always
　talk... turns out it was just to hide
　the resignation inside you」

stage0097_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$n
「And a man like that took my family's
　lives, and so many others', just for fun...」

stage0097_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$n
「Even if your planet was destroyed,
　does that justify what you did!?
　I will never forgive you!!」

stage0097_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'm a man who's tasted hell!
　Do you understand the anger and
　resignation of losing my homeworld... my people!?」

stage0097_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$n
「Shut up! Then do you understand
　my anger!?」

stage0097_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$n
「If you understand the weight of loss,
　why can't you understand what it means
　to take something away!!」

stage0097_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Torn between anger and resignation...
　How unsightly, $$ガドライト$$」

stage0097_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let me teach you a way out
　of that suffering」

stage0097_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's to kill, with your own hands,
　the one you love most, $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$,
　and let overwhelming rage consume you」

stage0097_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「They say a renowned painter once
　watched his own beloved daughter
　burn to death, to paint hell itself...」

stage0097_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You said you've tasted hell, but
　that's not enough. Only one who opens
　hell's door himself can climb higher」

stage0097_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$n
「Shut up, $$ガドライト$$!
　I won't give you anything more!!」

stage0097_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$n
「I'll do it, Miss $$スズネ$$...!
　Please lend me your strength!」

stage0097_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n! The $$ジェニオン$$'s GAI Mode
　limiter just maxed out!」

stage0097_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The time limit's gone now, but once
　this battle ends, the $$ジェニオン$$'s power unit
　will burn out completely, and then...」

stage0097_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It'll never be able to fight again!?」

stage0097_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$n
「I don't care...!
　Not if it means I can defeat him...
　$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!」

stage0097_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then give it everything you have!」

stage0097_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll clear out the enemies around you!」

stage0097_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$シン$$
「So you go after him...
　target $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0097_04:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You have good comrades」

stage0097_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now, the time has come for me
　to reveal my true identity to you」

stage0097_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I am the last one... forgotten...」

stage0097_04:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And I too, like you, am one who's been
　captivated by an angel...
　I fight to break that curse」

stage0097_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「This $$アスクレプス$$, like your $$ジェニオン$$,
　is power meant to strike them down」

stage0097_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's just as you sense.
　I wasn't born a human of this world」

stage0097_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Those who protect every world
　that exists... that's what we are」

stage0097_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Someday, we'll need you all to
　become that power too. But for now...」

stage0097_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's go, $n.
　We'll bring down the '$$いがみ合う双子$$',
　$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, here!」

stage0097_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$アドヴェント$$!
　Are you siding with him too!?」

stage0097_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Heaven helps those who help
　themselves... this is inevitable」

stage0097_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You should see it for yourself!
　The potential that humanity holds!!」

stage0097_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$スザク$$
「$$ジェミニア$$'s damage is healing!」

stage0097_04:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$キリコ$$
「So he's fighting for his life」

stage0097_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I won't lose...!
　I can't lose!」

stage0097_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If I lose to you here,
　what was the point of everything
　I've lived through!!」

stage0097_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$n
「Those words...!
　Say that again, in front of
　the lives you've taken!」

stage0097_04:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　This ends here!!」

stage0097_04:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$n
「The one who took my father
　and sister...! And Earth's enemy...!
　I'll beat you, me and $$ジェニオン$$!!」

stage0097_04:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「N-no way...!
　This can't be happening...!」

stage0097_04:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「At this rate, I'll...!
　No, $$アンナロッタ$$ will...!!」

stage0097_04:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$桂$$
「It's the same as with $$アイム$$ Liard!」

stage0097_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「An awakened $$スフィア・リアクター$$'s
　power is inexhaustible...!
　Can't we finish him off completely!?」

stage0097_04:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The '$$いがみ合う双子$$' draw power
　from conflicting emotion... sealing it needs
　the $$スフィア$$ that governs 'Lies', bending emotion by will」

stage0097_04:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アイム$$ Liard's '$$偽りの黒羊$$'!?」

stage0097_04:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then... are you saying we can't
　defeat him...!?」

stage0097_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Damn it...! Daaaaamn it!!
　What am I doing!
　This can't be right... this can't be riiiight!!」

stage0097_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you get away!」

stage0097_04:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I can't let you use the $$スフィア$$
　any further!」

stage0097_04:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Y-you...!
　It's always you, always getting in my way!
　That's why...! That's why!!」

stage0097_04:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let me free you from
　that suffering」

stage0097_04:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I see... I see...
　so that's how it was! Now I get it!」

stage0097_04:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...With this... your bickering
　twins' balance... has crumbled...」

stage0097_04:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now that... anger...
　has won out over resignation...
　your power... will collapse...」

stage0097_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You! So that's why...
　you did that to me...!」

stage0097_04:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'm sorry... $n...
　it seems I can't guide you
　after all......」

stage0097_04:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But... now...
　now... you can... defeat... him.........」

stage0097_04:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$n
「Why would you go that far
　for me...!?」

stage0097_04:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's my own... joy...
　Because, you are... my......」

stage0097_04:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト$$!
　You've taken from me again!
　You...!」

stage0097_04:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is the $$ジェニオン$$ not going to hold!?」

stage0097_04:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$n
「Move, $$ジェニオン$$! Move!!
　It's just one more hit!!」

stage0097_04:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$n
「$$アドヴェント$$ gave me this chance!
　Moooove!!」

stage0097_04:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Hope within despair...
　The conflicting emotions inside $n
　are tearing the $$スフィア$$ from $$ジェミニア$$...!」

stage0097_04:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Heh... What a joke I turned out to be...
　I've lived on the $$スフィア$$'s power,
　and done as I pleased with it, but...」

stage0097_04:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「In the end, Imitation stole my $$スフィア$$,
　and left me to die like a dog.」

stage0097_04:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$n
「That's the price for what you've done!」

stage0097_04:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yeah...
　I've got no excuse for that...」

stage0097_04:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But listen, $n!
　Someday, that power will swallow you too!」

stage0097_04:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't think you've won just because of this!
　Even if you beat me, you'll never beat them!」

stage0097_04:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahahahaha, hahahahaha!
　Make that red flower bloom before me again!」

stage0097_04:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So long, new Reactor who inherited the curse!
　Your mama's beckoning you from hell!!」

stage0097_04:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But this is merely the end of one battle.」

stage0097_04:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
Trooper
「To think the captain would fall in battle...」

stage0097_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:
Trooper
「But I believe that's what he wanted.
　After all, he was able to defeat $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.」

stage0097_04:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We're grateful for his cooperation, and mourn his death...」

stage0097_04:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
Trooper
「All we can do now is carry out our duty.
　The captain would have wanted that too.」

stage0097_04:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
Trooper
「Now that $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, both commander
　and $$スフィア・リアクター$$, has fallen,
　Geminis can be said to be wiped out.」

stage0097_04:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
Trooper
「Now that the Federation Forces have lost their
　fleet too, the Chrono conservative faction pulling
　Supreme Command's strings will have to fall silent as well.」

stage0097_04:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
Trooper
「Please leave the cleanup of the Geminis remnants
　and the Chrono conservative faction to us.」

stage0097_04:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Won't you share any information you have on Chrono?」

stage0097_04:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And what did $$アドヴェント$$'s last words mean...」

stage0097_04:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
Trooper
「...Allow us to explain that once it's all over.」

stage0097_04:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
Trooper
「You still have an enemy left to fight.」

stage0097_04:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$, huh.」

stage0097_04:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
Trooper
「They wanted to complete the $$エタニティ・フラット$$.
　Now that the Prison of Time has been destroyed,
　they'll likely begin a full-scale invasion.」

stage0097_04:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'm not waiting around for that.
　We're storming their home base, and this time
　we'll settle this for good!」

stage0097_04:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$シモン$$
「And I will save $$ニア$$, no matter what!」

stage0097_04:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
Trooper
「Earth and the colonies will also strengthen
　their defenses against a $$バアル$$ attack.」

stage0097_04:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
Trooper
「Humanity's last hope against the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　We're entrusting it to you.」

stage0097_04:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
Trooper
「Let us believe in your victory.」

stage0097_04:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Guess we have no choice but to do it.」

stage0097_04:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Whether it's $$バアル$$ or the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$,
　we'll take them on!」

stage0097_04:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$刹那$$
「But do you even know where the
　$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s home base is?」

stage0097_04:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I have an idea about that.」

stage0097_04:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$リーロン$$
「OK!
　We're counting on you, $$ロージェノム$$.」

stage0097_04:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$シモン$$
（Wait for me, $$ニア$$...
　I'll definitely come save you.）

stage0097_04:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$n
「My fight ended when I defeated $$ガドライト$$...」

stage0097_04:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$n
「But $c's fight continues.
　So I... we should go too.」

stage0097_04:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$n
（Thank you, $$アドヴェント$$...
　I'll make the most of the hope you gave me...）

stage0097_04:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$n
（And $$ガドライト$$...
　I will never yield to the despair you left behind...）

stage0097_04:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$n
（I'll fight in the space between hope
　and despair... with this $$ジェニオン$$...）

stage0097_04:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「H-how careless of me...!」

stage0097_04:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Fall back, $$アンナロッタ$$!」

stage0097_04:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you and the child in your belly die,
　that's the end of the Geminaid!」

stage0097_04:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Even so, I don't care!」

stage0097_04:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If losing someone you love is what brings back
　your rage and your pride, then I...!」

stage0097_04:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Without paying a price like that,
　can I not fight at all...」

stage0097_04:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't worry, $$アンナロッタ$$.
　I won't lose, even without doing something like that.」

stage0097_04:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll wrap this up in no time and be right back.
　Love you, my sweet honey.」

stage0097_04:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If something happens to me, run...
　Get away from Earth before he gets here.」

stage0097_04:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$n
「Guess even a bastard's gentle with his own woman.」

stage0097_04:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Look at this brat, talking like he's somebody.」

stage0097_04:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But don't get the wrong idea.
　She's less my woman than she is
　the future mother of the Geminaid.」

stage0097_04:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「To keep the Geminaid bloodline alive,
　I won't let a thing happen to her!」

stage0097_04:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And for that, I'll finish you off here for sure!」

stage0097_04:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「$n!
　I won't let you get anywhere near the captain!」

stage0097_04:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$n
「Get out of the way, $$アンナロッタ$$!
　I'll deal with you after I take him down!」

stage0097_04:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「A world without him means nothing to me...!
　Even at the cost of my own life, I'll save him...!」

stage0097_04:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$n
「...$$アンナロッタ$$...
　Maybe you're not such a bad person
　after all...」

stage0097_04:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$n
「But listen!
　No matter what circumstances you had, I won't
　forgive you... no, all of you!!」

stage0097_04:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$n
「What do you mean, 'even at the cost of my life'!
　Because of the war you people started,
　some had their lives taken for nothing!」

stage0097_04:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$n
「Maybe you had your own reasons too...
　But I've got no interest in hearing them!
　I'll never listen to them!」

stage0097_04:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$n
「What you've done isn't even war!
　How could I ever forgive people like you!」

stage0097_04:r_53dd6bae12e095c3.text:
$n
「$$アンナロッタ$$!
　You've all come too far to turn back now!
　You'd better realize that!!」

stage0097_04:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...That's fine, $n!
　Fight me with everything you've got!」

stage0097_04:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Come on, brat...!
　I'll teach you what the real world is like!」

stage0097_04:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I do feel bad about what happened to your planet!
　But that's a whole different matter!」

stage0097_04:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't act all high and mighty like an adult
　when all you do is take it out on other planets!」

stage0097_04:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Shut up!
　Then I'll beat into you just how scary
　adults are, and how angry I am!」

stage0097_04:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't back down from a threat like that!
　At this point, adult or kid, who cares!」

stage0097_04:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll definitely protect it all!
　My company's vault, and Earth's peace too!!」

stage0097_04:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Come on, Mars!
　Try saving us Geminaids with that
　power of love you're always going on about!」

stage0097_04:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Your greatest sin is letting your own sorrow
　defeat you, and trying to drag others
　into misfortune along with you!」

stage0097_04:r_78ebe98c49194738.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I've had enough of your sermons!
　So what could I have done, huh!?」

stage0097_04:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「All I could do was drink my sorrows away
　and watch the people of this planet
　kill each other, that's all!」

stage0097_04:r_7c9a719cd8f27d1d.text:
$$タケル$$
「You must have anger in you too!
　You could've done more than just
　drown in resignation!」

stage0097_04:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't talk like you know me!
　What do you know about the anger inside me!」

stage0097_04:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$タケル$$
「Then I'll show you our anger!
　You tried to steal Earth's future,
　and I will never forgive you for it!」

stage0097_04:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You piece of junk!
　Keep clinging to me, and I'll scrap you!」

stage0097_04:r_9496bdb991cf236a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is the Sun's messenger... our hope!
　There's no way $$鉄人$$ will lose
　to someone who gave in to despair like you!」

stage0097_04:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Look who's talking, brat!
　I'll smash that precious toy of yours
　and enjoy watching you cry!」

stage0097_04:r_dc9b1e7f62a8afc8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't let someone who fights just for fun
　do whatever he wants with our Earth!」

stage0097_04:r_a93aa11c23414e87.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　After the Prison of Time, next we take down
　Geminis, the cause of it all!!」

stage0097_04:r_cbab585f941e5667.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You $$異能生存体$$!
　Even with a 1 in 25 billion chance,
　you still can't overturn fate!」

stage0097_04:r_06e36bd71f54f272.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Like I'd lose to a man who couldn't
　save the woman he loved! I...」

stage0097_04:r_978bd43401f7be8a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「No, I'll say it!
　You're a fool who couldn't save
　the woman you loved!」

stage0097_04:r_e9bd6b1804d36e0a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But don't worry!
　I'll send you off to join her!」

stage0097_04:r_1f65c397b9d1833d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「That's not what $$フィアナ$$ wants.」

stage0097_04:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A true singularity!
　I can't forgive you for merely existing!」

stage0097_04:r_4cb558f092561fde.text:
$$桂$$
「Does it really bother you that much
　that I caused the $$大時空震動$$?」

stage0097_04:r_119dbefe27cdac46.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's not it...!
　I won't accept your existence, protected
　just because you're a singularity!」

stage0097_04:r_56176fc60ad96ecd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's why you were dragged into this world!
　To hide you, your partner, and that person
　from them!」

stage0097_04:r_577385dbd6d74922.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You don't need to know that!
　I'll crush you right here!」

stage0097_04:r_ee134f0fa96047a6.text:
$$桂$$
「Getting tangled in nonsense logic like that
　is something I've been used to since that day,
　but I've got zero intention of caving to it!」

stage0097_04:r_204e41a08c5ec720.text:
$$桂$$
「I've got a place to go home to!
　Now that the dimensional cage is broken,
　I'll restore peace and find my way back to Mimsy!」

stage0097_04:r_c1cddb7853813703.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So you've come, Newtype!
　Let's see what you've got!」

stage0097_04:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Newtype isn't a power for war!
　I'm not a weapon!」

stage0097_04:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Pretty words like that make me sick!
　Fact is, you've been fighting
　with that power all along!」

stage0097_04:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But don't worry.
　With that fighting strength of yours,
　you might just be allowed to live!」

stage0097_04:r_9d5428667d48c806.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just like me and Geminis!」

stage0097_04:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「My life is mine!
　I don't intend to live
　by anyone else's permission!」

stage0097_04:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And if my power can defeat you,
　I won't hesitate to fight!
　I'll end this, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!」

stage0097_04:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If it was gonna turn out like this,
　I should've let $$フロンタル$$ finish you
　off from the start!」

stage0097_04:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Because you existed, $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　realized he was a singularity, and started
　spouting pretty words about the world!」

stage0097_04:r_b101d62bbac1b33b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「By rights, he should've just run on
　rivalry toward you and dropped $$アクシズ$$
　on Earth! Why'd it end up like this!」

stage0097_04:r_05b808b1583f5be2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's because he learned
　to carve out his own fate!」

stage0097_04:r_6bdc8a8243c655ed.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if I'd fallen along the way,
　the $$シャア$$ of today would surely
　have saved this world!」

stage0097_04:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Damn it!
　Don't go thinking you've already won!」

stage0097_04:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's it, I'm done playing watchdog!
　I'll beat you down and tear
　the Earth to pieces!」

stage0097_04:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Like I'll let you!
　You tried to snuff out humanity's potential,
　and I'll be the one to face you for it!」

stage0097_04:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If $$シャア$$ is to guide the world,
　then I'll just be the one who protects it!」

stage0097_04:r_1c9bf7ffbf9314a5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　You really pulled something uncalled for!」

stage0097_04:r_b402ecf2db57f319.text:
$$シャア$$
「From the moment I caught your shadow,
　I have fought as $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　for this very day!」

stage0097_04:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
$$シャア$$
「After that, once you're defeated,
　humanity will begin walking forward
　again on its own two feet!」

stage0097_04:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Seems you understand you've
　outlived your usefulness! Then I'll
　be the one to send you off!」

stage0097_04:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$$シャア$$
「That said, I have no intention
　of being an outlet for the
　emotions of a man like you!」

stage0097_04:r_b251d2d3a7cdba85.text:
$$シャア$$
「I too am a man once called
　the Red Comet! I won't fall behind
　a small-minded man drowning in emotion!」

stage0097_04:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Everything you've done has been for nothing.
　From here, $$リリーナ$$ and the others
　will clean up the war's aftermath.」

stage0097_04:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Like hell it will!
　The war's far from over!」

stage0097_04:r_b76534e2de5b6334.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now that the dimensional cage
　is smashed, there's no more room
　for roundabout methods!」

stage0097_04:r_ee41ea400d1ee0bf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'm not gonna wait around for
　you all to turn on each other!
　I'll wreck that planet myself!」

stage0097_04:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you're coming at us directly,
　all the better. Defeat just you,
　and the fight is over.」

stage0097_04:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed.
　Attack objective: $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...!」

stage0097_04:r_a5181af1cc2bdd02.text:
$$シン$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　I will never forgive you
　for starting this war!」

stage0097_04:r_357749a704e3cf55.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't get the wrong idea!
　All I did was give a little push
　to those who already wanted war!」

stage0097_04:r_9da55d8320b82bc6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you wanna vent your anger, shouldn't it
　go to them too? Don't tell me you're pulling
　the 'tricked victim' card!?」

stage0097_04:r_8d5dbaa0f1e069de.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't need you to tell me that!」

stage0097_04:r_301d85713d2cddd7.text:
$$シン$$
「We've beaten down Neo Zeon!
　All that's left is to defeat you
　and corner Chrono!」

stage0097_04:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quite the confidence, kid!
　But that grand ambition of yours
　stops right here with me!」

stage0097_04:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$シン$$
「Like I'd lose to the likes of you!
　I won't stop until I've
　ended every war!!」

stage0097_04:r_b77f3e5c390fe067.text:
$$キラ$$
「Do you have any idea how many lives
　have been lost because of
　what you've done!」

stage0097_04:r_fa7a261c85f92c5a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I've got no interest in counting
　the tally along the way.
　In the end, everyone dies anyway.」

stage0097_04:r_16141de28d738543.text:
$$キラ$$
「You, who lost your home world,
　why would you do such a thing...!?」

stage0097_04:r_39d8b5a2657c65a4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's the biggest reason there is!
　Don't think you lot can run
　from disaster alone, damn it!」

stage0097_04:r_1a123affe838b8b1.text:
$$キラ$$
「If you're going to keep on
　repeating that sorrow, then I...!」

stage0097_04:r_fb72b64c842ba487.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What do YOU want to do, huh?
　Say it. Straight out!」

stage0097_04:r_f9ff2a77c392a048.text:
$$キラ$$
「From here, words aren't needed...!
　I'll defeat you with this power
　and these feelings!」

stage0097_04:r_3167d694c10c96fb.text:
$$キラ$$
「My resolve is to stake this body
　of mine on ridding the world
　of sorrow!!」

stage0097_04:r_5dcadcd6c77bc7dc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Even you, this so-called Innovator,
　don't seem to understand
　the anger and resignation in me!」

stage0097_04:r_f22e056851da9461.text:
$$刹那$$
「I do feel that!
　What I can't understand is why
　that led you to destroy the Earth!」

stage0097_04:r_84e951432a30244f.text:
$$刹那$$
「What meaning is there in spreading
　the sorrow you yourselves suffered!?」

stage0097_04:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Ha! You're gonna make me
　spell that out for you?
　You're plenty cruel yourself!」

stage0097_04:r_c8b34405ed7bfde7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If I bawled pathetically and said
　I was frustrated, that I envied you,
　would that satisfy you, huh!?」

stage0097_04:r_286cd6be5271ecd2.text:
$$刹那$$
「...You never tried to understand
　others' pain... No, you knew it
　and ignored it, to protect your own heart!」

stage0097_04:r_d7cd6f0e351ca403.text:
$$刹那$$
「I can't hand our world over
　to a man like that!
　We will eradicate your war!!」

stage0097_04:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You! Do you even understand
　what you were trying to do!?」

stage0097_04:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I was trying to hold back $$バアル$$'s
　invasion with the dimensional cage.
　You could at least thank me, Earthling.」

stage0097_04:r_5f455447e0703bcf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No! What you were trying to do
　was kill the future...
　kill possibility!」

stage0097_04:r_378632856490e9d0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A world without life or death
　has no meaning! Everyone
　chose the future!」

stage0097_04:r_0a93eeae43e226f4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You're annoying!
　Fine then, I'll destroy Earth myself
　before $$バアル$$ even gets here!」

stage0097_04:r_49dde825db6b02a0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And I'll teach you this!
　You're huge idiots who turned down
　a perfectly good mercy!」

stage0097_04:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you do that!
　We'll protect the future ourselves!」

stage0097_04:r_7fd3cd80460fefb1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「And we've got the power
　for that in our hands!!」

stage0097_04:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$葵$$
「The day I finally pay you back
　has come!」

stage0097_04:r_cd3b88564d0672c9.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「And the future that
　keeps going on!」

stage0097_04:r_ed6e99341ad5bf40.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What an annoying bunch!
　If we're gonna talk about what's
　been taken, mine's on another level!」

stage0097_04:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$$葵$$
「It's not about quantity!
　We won't forgive what you've done!」

stage0097_04:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's pointless! No matter how
　angry you get, some opponents in
　this world you just can't beat!」

stage0097_04:r_ed9690679f1aa20f.text:
$$葵$$
「Don't lump us in with you,
　ruled by resignation! I'll show you
　the power of what you stole from us!」

stage0097_04:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$葵$$
「You can't stop our blood
　from boiling! It burns bright red,
　together with our anger!」

stage0097_04:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$葵$$
「Get ready, $$ガドライト$$!
　Let's do this!!」

stage0097_04:r_f0ce8e3e0d75533e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I can't live carefree like you!」

stage0097_04:r_87e728176c45393f.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「No matter the circumstances,
　what you've done can't be forgiven!」

stage0097_04:r_5aa4e72c511af6eb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You say that, but could you
　say the same if you'd ended up
　in my position!」

stage0097_04:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's why I'll put it to the test!
　By taking everything from you!」

stage0097_04:r_5c0f74cc35812a77.text:
$$バサラ$$
「No matter what happens, my song
　can't be taken! Crush my throat, tear
　my tongue out, my soul sings on!」

stage0097_04:r_0bb68446ec330a05.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Is there nothing left in you
　that can set your heart ablaze!」

stage0097_04:r_84158af5a79e4d35.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Empty your heart and
　listen to my song! Set your
　heart ablaze once more!」

stage0097_04:r_4c845bb8b05d3b13.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ガドライト$$! I'll defeat you here
　and crush Geminis' ambitions!」

stage0097_04:r_836fc0eae35929e9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quite the spirit.
　Like a young lion who knows no fear!」

stage0097_04:r_aed2fc42c9a9ecdd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But! I haven't fallen so far
　that momentum alone can take me down!」

stage0097_04:r_ebc3eec9f9e218b1.text:
$$アルト$$
「I've got no interest in the words
　of someone who drowned in resignation
　and tried to destroy Earth out of spite!」

stage0097_04:r_271fbb35b579a866.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well said! But even someone
　like me still has something left!
　That's exactly why I can't lose!」

stage0097_04:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（$$アンナロッタ$$...
　I'll win this fight, and protect
　at least you...!）

stage0097_04:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$アルト$$
「I can't afford to lose either!
　Let's go!!」

stage0097_04:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$アルト$$
（$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$...!
　Your future... I'll protect it,
　I swear it!）

stage0097_04:r_47c1edbfd5664fd7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're a real joke, $$ガドライト$$!
　I'll give you your skill, but your
　character's rotten to the core!」

stage0097_04:r_fbdb8764f80a1b12.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Shut up, Earthling!
　What do you know about me...
　about the Geminaids!」

stage0097_04:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$弁慶$$
「There it is!
　The classic villain excuse!」

stage0097_04:r_bba76accfb31e66d.text:
$$隼人$$
「Since you resorted to
　such underhanded tactics,
　I've no interest in your excuses.」

stage0097_04:r_199a6e6247ffb58b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Is that so! Then I'll force it
　on you too, by sheer strength!
　The same fate we walked!」

stage0097_04:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If you can do it, try it!
　Didn't figure talking things out
　with you would get us anywhere!」

stage0097_04:r_ad702e22165a11de.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on!
　My Getter will smash
　that $$スフィア$$ of yours!!」

stage0097_04:r_df79b5dc7ceda4c0.text:
$$甲児$$
「Like I'd let you get away, $$ガドライト$$!
　Today, I'll settle this for good!」

stage0097_04:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Running away?
　Don't make me laugh, Earthling!」

stage0097_04:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Still don't get the difference
　in power, huh! Not even standing
　on your head could you beat me!」

stage0097_04:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$甲児$$
「You know full well the fate
　of villains who said that
　and underestimated us!」

stage0097_04:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$甲児$$
「Whether it's a black hole, the $$堕天翅$$
　race, a god of Mycenae, or a $$スフィア・リアクター$$,
　nothing can stop our anger!」

stage0097_04:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Then I'll cast you all down
　into despair myself!」

stage0097_04:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Like hell I'll lose!
　I won't hand our future and Earth's
　future over to someone like you!」

stage0097_04:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A salaryman waltzing on over
　to a place like this, that's
　the end of your luck!」

stage0097_04:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$赤木$$
「Shut up, you coward!
　Even a salaryman can protect the peace!」

stage0097_04:r_173107393504e4d1.text:
$$いぶき$$
「He brought out his
　catchphrase first thing!」

stage0097_04:r_48e8a7d08b0e09ba.text:
$$赤木$$
「Of course! Today's the day
　I punch this guy out and
　bring peace back for everyone!」

stage0097_04:r_7d5585f6d8b1df8d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quit joking around! Peace is never
　coming back to this planet again!
　Even if you manage to beat me!」

stage0097_04:r_5933be40e8f9d954.text:
$$赤木$$
「If $$バアル$$ or the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$
　are coming after you, we'll beat
　them too!」

stage0097_04:r_0d848a222f69347d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Remember this, $$ガドライト$$!
　This is what you forgot when you gave up:
　a heart that believes in hope and the future!!」

stage0097_04:r_bd5c0088c2d22ef6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Cold, aren't you, $$ロジャー$$!
　And here I've bought you so many drinks!」

stage0097_04:r_77fc21c69be0890c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I already thanked you for that.
　Our accounts are already even」

stage0097_04:r_7b9baf664ed0cd70.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't get cocky, smooth talker!
　You think I'm on the same level as you?」

stage0097_04:r_a0fcf4d8788a2bce.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Drop the bravado, $$ガドライト$$.
　The more you puff yourself up,
　the more pathetic you look to me」

stage0097_04:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And if you'd like to revise your opinion of me,
　now is the time. Otherwise, you'll regret it」

stage0097_04:r_dae622560a4cfc83.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Regret? I ran out of that feeling long ago!
　Otherwise I wouldn't be doing something this stupid!」

stage0097_04:r_aa09da82b4c52a2a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see...
　It seems you're seeking punishment」

stage0097_04:r_d0acd2176373fca3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Shut it, you con man!」

stage0097_04:r_c2f74d776b632961.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Consider this thanks for the drinks you bought me!
　$$ビッグオー$$ and I will take on that role!」

stage0097_04:r_55d74e6e4298cda9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　You stand guilty!!」

stage0097_04:r_2e7c2f5aef3a7531.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I know, $$ゼロ$$.
　There's a reason you're still alive like this」

stage0097_04:r_e1b7430fdaa24f35.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now that you've become an heir to that legacy too,
　you must understand a little, right!?
　Why the dimensional cage was built!」

stage0097_04:r_e4dc8237ad7169a2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「An act that robs someone of their future is no mercy!
　I choose the future over the past, over the present!」

stage0097_04:r_ced1bbcf059b07d7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「And that is the answer every person in the world has chosen!」

stage0097_04:r_dda2f4922920a4e0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Is that so!
　Then go regret that choice in hell!」

stage0097_04:r_20cd18288d206a35.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let me tell you something, $$ガドライト$$!
　We have no intention of going to hell...
　or to Time-Hell, either!」

stage0097_04:r_683f2ca0d6804be4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I am $$ゼロ$$!
　A man who calls forth miracles for victory!
　I'll make you understand that as well!!」

stage0097_04:r_d96c64f9a77d53aa.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll make you all taste
　even a fraction of the despair I've known!」

stage0097_04:r_1a9b7326b53f45cc.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have no interest in your background or feelings.
　As long as you stand on the battlefield,
　you are nothing but my enemy」

stage0097_04:r_02b69055356d9cfb.text:
$$宗介$$
「To me, an enemy exists only to be eliminated.
　If you want to tell your life story, go drink
　and find some drunk to listen to you」

stage0097_04:r_c4554163734c62f1.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Look who's talking!
　You don't know a thing about my...」

stage0097_04:r_890ab04baf542979.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you have time to waste running your mouth!
　You total amateur」

stage0097_04:r_4bea4465e893e4b0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You bastard!
　You want a taste of my skill that badly,
　from me, Geminis' top ace!」

stage0097_04:r_7123af524c72acf7.text:
$$宗介$$
「A soldier who puts up a front like that
　is never worth much, in any world」

stage0097_04:r_0b8e88db1a9dd44e.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　The worst soldier, and the worst commander!
　I will bring you down!」

stage0097_04:r_a4798a17c691a81a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you've got a woman you love, get off Earth
　right now! That's the last kindness I've got!」

stage0097_04:r_31f18ff9dc8f076e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Like I could do that!
　I swore to protect our planet!」

stage0097_04:r_b4515f604561df78.text:
$$アマタ$$
「My father, my mother... and the woman I love, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0097_04:r_533e554662b8c631.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I always believe in the future!
　I'll even go beyond destiny!」

stage0097_04:r_b06b2a23a76e8ce4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's right, $$アマタ$$!
　You have wings for that very purpose!」

stage0097_04:r_cbff35a90e8ad7cd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Surrounded by the woman you love and your friends,
　you're a lucky bastard, you are!」

stage0097_04:r_26db4dd6c24f9835.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But you know what!
　Seeing that kind of thing makes my skin crawl!」

stage0097_04:r_d224d5baf3493ab2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's my line, $$ガドライト$$!
　You who envy others and treat lives like insects,
　we will bring you down!」

stage0097_04:r_3ee3743094a4a145.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go!
　We'll defeat you and protect the future!!」

stage0097_04:r_180eb1536d754e3c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Tough luck for you too, huh.
　Dragged into this world by force,
　as some kind of just-in-case insurance!」

stage0097_04:r_015674a403ccf13a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I have no intention of listening to what you say!」

stage0097_04:r_ef91c7636fe8aad4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But I'll say one thing!
　I'm glad I came to this world!」

stage0097_04:r_397bc0c659cbf227.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't kid yourself!
　What's good about a planet that's nothing but war!?」

stage0097_04:r_f2effcece0132e9d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I do hate war, that's true!
　But everyone in this world is living
　with everything they've got!」

stage0097_04:r_f7c5d0246e396cd5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Just like the Earth I came from,
　everyone here is living for the future!」

stage0097_04:r_7aa9edfa8692bb8d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Not knowing that future is pitch black...!」

stage0097_04:r_994d9e1d2a462e94.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then I'll light up that darkness!
　With $$ガンバスター$$'s flames!」

stage0097_04:r_4fec64c622a0514b.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「And I will defeat you!
　To protect everyone's future!!」

stage0097_04:r_20d5fb63b23b2310.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Man of the Spiral!
　No matter how much power you gain,
　what waits at the end of it is despair!」

stage0097_04:r_f30ba6c950a686bc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This guy...!
　Isn't he listening to what I'm saying!?」

stage0097_04:r_6bfb2bfe97891db7.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It's pointless, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.
　$$シモン$$'s mind is already fixed
　on the decisive battle with the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$」

stage0097_04:r_96474b2c3a6e7165.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The words of someone like you,
　drowning in resignation and trying to forget his anger,
　will never reach $$シモン$$'s ears」

stage0097_04:r_5bf2ab7960121e96.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You've got some nerve!
　Fine, then, let me teach you something!
　The wind's path... where the Spiral leads is despair!」

stage0097_04:r_023f1f7532dd508f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Get out of the way, $$ガドライト$$!
　I don't have time to deal with you!」

stage0097_04:r_3a4a5d03e079f53d.text:
$$シモン$$
「My drill is headed straight for where $$ニア$$ is!
　I'll punch through anyone who gets in the way!」

stage0097_04:r_037dafa5c5124420.text:
$$シモン$$
「My drill is a drill that punches through despair
　and carves out a path to hoooope!!」

stage0097_04:r_b126c5fbf2356174.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Too bad, kid!
　Until now, I deliberately let your machine go,
　thinking it would become a 'Door'!」

stage0097_04:r_88aa7aea54616b53.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But that's over now!
　I'm not waiting around for something as tedious
　as remaking the world, or your old man's schedule!」

stage0097_04:r_e44c30f3b562be6c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why does my father come into this!?」

stage0097_04:r_4711ef8ef992a14e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「There are things in this world better left unknown!
　I'll send you to the afterlife without you knowing a thing!」

stage0097_04:r_8e980fa9b6fbb694.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't want to live without knowing anything,
　and I don't want to be killed by someone either!
　I have things I want to do too!」

stage0097_04:r_6a06cc16f6683240.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm sure everyone else feels the same way!
　That's why I chose $$時空修復$$!」

stage0097_04:r_e2efb08e47011ced.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll fight for those people too!
　I'm a member of $c!!」

stage0097_04:r_d1f368432258ec05.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「At this point, it doesn't matter anymore
　what that imitation of yours even is!」

stage0097_04:r_7317f048fc262114.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's strange...!
　When we met at the bar, I didn't dislike you...
　if anything, I even found you likable!」

stage0097_04:r_3efe6b08505e6b39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Birds of a feather are drawn together...
　But you found something in $n
　that was decisively different from yourself...」

stage0097_04:r_889b93ef12326ef0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「At that moment, fondness turns to hatred.
　Just like quarreling twins」

stage0097_04:r_fd9bcf7d78c6eeac.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't go peeking into people's hearts!」

stage0097_04:r_83d6f0d49d974865.text:
$n
「A heart?
　You still have one of those left?」

stage0097_04:r_d19e2d3230e09c6a.text:
$n
「Swallowed by resignation, forgetting your anger,
　and scattering misfortune onto others...!
　How could a machine piloted by a man like that be anyone's hope or pride!」

stage0097_04:r_807f7b4a12c3c6ab.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You bastard...!
　My $$ジェミニア$$...!」

stage0097_04:r_857468de19815523.text:
$n
「I despise you!
　Not hate, not loathe, despise!」

stage0097_04:r_72f66f82d72a5e2c.text:
$n
「I refuse to become a man like you!
　That's why I will defeat you!!」

stage0097_04:r_02497c17fe7cb67c.text:
$n
「Killer of my father and sister, enemy of Earth!
　And my own personal enemy!
　Let's settle this, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!」

stage0097_04:r_8455446770647f64.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't come near me!
　Don't you dare come here, you bear-rat!」

stage0097_04:r_4f6b361fd2c92e92.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Pig-cat!
　Whenever you show up, it throws off my balance!」

stage0097_04:r_d9f2b8012ba37fc5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't tell me you're also a $$スフィア・リアクター$$,
　sapping my will to fight!」

stage0097_04:r_62cbe4ab456fe01c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Damn it! Daaaaamn it!!
　I surrender, I admit it!」

stage0097_04:r_de0d7af4922e4e7a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You're actually kind of cute, you little bastard!!」

stage0097_04:r_bdfba076c58e1ff5.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ヴィラル$$, $$ロージェノム$$!」

stage0097_04:r_e93d2827733385fa.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've taken charge of all your lives!」

stage0097_04:r_891efb3059812af8.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this!
　This soul-drill of $$超銀河グレンラガン$$...!
　I'll spin it at full power!!」
